senses.gloss: m. (cmp. preced., a. שַׁבְּלוּל) [snail,] rope, rope-ladder; [oth. opin. basket, cmp. יְבַל].
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 33b:5">B. Bath. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>האי מאן דנקיט מגלא ות׳ וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. a. Rashi <cite ref="V00148"><he>תּוֹבִילָא</he></cite>) if one takes a pruning knife and a rope (basket), and says, I will cut the dates of such and such a man’s palm <cite ref="Bava Batra 36a:3">ib. 36ᵃ</cite>.
